@claude what time does tate modern close on a friday and is general entry actually free

Tate Modern closes at 9pm on Fridays, and the last entry is 30 minutes before that. Entry to the main collection is free for everyone. Special exhibitions usually cost extra, and Tate recommends booking those. Tate Collective tickets are £5 if you're 16–25.

https://www.tate.org.uk/visit/tate-modern
